title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-i98v: lichen-oscore has 43 compile errors
description:
## Summary
`cargo test --no-run -p lichen-oscore` fails with 43 compile errors in the library test code (lib.rs).

## Error Categories

### P0: Duplicate test helpers (E0428, E0119, E0592)
`TestStore`, `TestProtect`, and `for_context` defined twice in lib.rs tests module — merging/refactoring artifact from previous API migration.

### P0: protect_response missing `include_piv` argument (E0061)
12 call sites pass 5 args to `protect_response()` but signature now requires 6 (added `include_piv: bool`).

### P0: `Context::load_existing` removed but still called (E0599)
3 call sites in lib.rs still use the removed `load_existing` constructor.

### P1: `OscoreSeqNum::new` type mismatch (E0308)
Multiple test sites pass `u32` to `OscoreSeqNum::new` which expects `u64`.

### P1: `Option<OscoreSeqNum>` unwrap needed (E0599)
`increment()`, `fetch_increment()`, `get()`, `encode_piv()` called on `Option<OscoreSeqNum>` instead of unwrapped `OscoreSeqNum`.

### P1: `derive_key`/`derive_iv` type mismatch (E0308)
Test code passes `&id_context` (`&Vec<u8>`) but functions now expect `Option<&[u8]>` — needs `Some(&id_context)`.

### P2: Ambiguous `TestStore::for_context` (E0034)
~13 call sites get ambiguity errors due to duplicate definitions.

## Impact
Library and tests cannot compile — blocking all development and CI.

## Files
- `rust/lichen-oscore/src/lib.rs` — test module has all 43 errors
- `rust/lichen-oscore/src/seqnum.rs` — type mismatches in seqnum tests
- `rust/lichen-oscore/tests/vectors.rs` — this file's rewrite is correct, issue is in lib.rs
